summary: The thin bar over the content: a search field at its start, the trail to the current screen, the button that opens the command palette, and the screen's actions at its end. On a phone the trail keeps its last crumb and the palette's button is an icon.

anatomy.bar: The strip over the content, as tall as the rail's head: the sidebar ground and a rule under it. Shell's header draws it around the top bar, and AppBar for a screen drawn without the shell.
anatomy.menu: The button at the bar's start that opens the rail as the shell's drawer: below 768, or at every width while the rail is hidden. The shell's, named by its words.menu.
anatomy.mark: The app's mark on a small tile before the rest, for a screen without the rail that carries it.
anatomy.search: The app's search field at the bar's start, before the trail, so it stays in one place from screen to screen; / focuses it. Below 768 it gives way to the palette's button.
anatomy.trail: The crumbs to the current screen, after the search field, taking the room left; named by words.trail.
anatomy.crumb: One step of the trail: a link with href, else plain words; the current screen's crumb is marked as the page. A code crumb is in the code face.
anatomy.chevron: Between crumbs, and after the last when the trail ends at an ancestor; not drawn below 768.
anatomy.backChevron: Below 768, with the trail ending at an ancestor: a chevron pointing back before the last crumb, which is the way back.
anatomy.palette: The button that opens the command palette. With no search field: field-like, 224 wide, a magnifier, the word Search and the keys. Beside a search field: the keys alone when bound, else the magnifier. Below 768: an icon, a finger square, with no edge or ground.
anatomy.keys: The keys that open the palette, drawn only when bound: in a key cap with no search field, as plain small code text beside one.
anatomy.actions: The screen's actions at the bar's end, after the palette's button.

trail.does: [{ label, href?, code? }]: the screens above and the current one. In a Shell, a mounted screen's own trail (useShellTrail) is drawn in place of the bar's.

trailEnds.does: current: the last crumb is the current screen, plain words marked as the page, and on a phone the only crumb shown. ancestor: the trail holds only the screens above, whose page heading names the current one; every crumb with an href is a link, a chevron follows the last, and on a phone the last crumb alone is the way back.

mark.does: The app's mark before the rest, where no rail shows it.

search.does: A search field at the bar's start, such as SearchField or Search with its results under it.

palette.does: Whether the palette's button is drawn; false leaves it out even in a shell that holds a palette, as for a top bar drawn as a specimen on a page.

onSearch.does: Opens the palette from its button; in a Shell with a palette the button opens the shell's. No button without either.

shortcut.does: The keys shown in the palette's button: given by an app that binds them itself, or the shell's Mod+K as the device writes it (shortcutLabel). Shown only when bound.

actions.does: The screen's actions, at the bar's end.

inShell.does: In a Shell: a mounted screen's stated trail replaces the bar's own, and the palette's button opens the shell's palette with its keys shown.

menu.does: The menu button at the bar's start, for the rail's drawer: below 768, or at every width while the shell's rail is hidden.
menu.context: Shell: md:hidden unless railMode is hidden

panelToggle.does: A shell panel's toggle stands in the window's corner over the bar's end while the panel is closed or a sheet: the bar keeps 48 at its end for it.

trafficLights.does: In a desktop window with its title bar hidden: the bar is the window's drag region, and leaves spacing-traffic-lights at its start where no rail head does.

bar.note: gap: between the menu button and the top bar's own row.

content.note: The top bar's own row: the mark, the search field, the trail, the palette's button and the actions, 12 apart.

search.note: 224, 256 from 1024, at most 320; it may shrink.

palette.note: 224 wide with no search field (from 768). Below 768 a finger square, its icon centered, no pad.

paletteBesideField.note: Beside a search field, from 768: as wide as the keys or the magnifier.

panelToggleRoom.note: The bar's end pad while a shell panel's toggle stands in the corner.

trafficLights.note: The bar's start pad in a desktop window where no rail head leaves the room.

phoneBelow.note: The md breakpoint: below it the last crumb alone, the palette as an icon, the search field gone.

hover.means: The pointer over a crumb that is a link, the palette's button or the menu button.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the palette's button or a crumb.
focus.sokkel-ui: The palette's button: focus-visible:border-ring ring-1. A crumb's link and the menu button take the browser's outline, in ring/50 (base.css).

current.means: The current screen's crumb, the last when the trail ends at the current screen.

rest.note: In the trail's text.body; cut short with an ellipsis when the trail runs out of room.

hover.note: A crumb that is a link.

rest.note: The key cap with no search field. Beside one, the keys are 13/20 code text in the button's ink, with no cap.

keyboard.does: Reaches the menu button, the search field, each crumb that is a link, the palette's button and the actions, in that order.

keyboard.when: a search field that binds it, focus outside a field

appText.shortcut: The keys that open the palette, as the device writes them (shortcutLabel in sokkel-ui).
appText.actions: The actions follow their context: on Runs the button is New, not New run.

sokkel-ui: Shell's header (and AppBar) draws the bar; TopBar draws the row inside it. A screen draws its own bar with ShellTop, or states its trail with useShellTrail.
Crumbs are Link, drawn as the app's LinkProvider says.
The breakpoint is a media query (max-md, md:hidden): the crumbs before the last, the chevrons and the search field are hidden below 768.
With no search field the palette's button is named words.search and says it; beside one it is named words.palette, which its title shows.
In a desktop window (Shell desktop, AppBar desktop) the bar is a window drag region (data-window-drag).
sokkel-ui-egui: A crumb with an href is a route the app goes to on a press; there are no URLs.
The bar is a fixed strip the Shell gives a rect; the trail is laid out left to right and the end's controls right to left, so a long trail is cut short before them.
The window's width is the available rect: the phone layout below 768 is chosen by width, not a media query.

drift.spec: The palette's button, then the screen's actions at the very end, 12 apart; the actions 6 apart.
drift.today: As of 267236c: the actions, then the palette's button at the very end, 6 apart.

drift.spec: 4 between a crumb and a chevron.
On keyboard focus only: the edge in ring and a 1px ring.
drift.today: The shared focus_ring: 2 wide, 2 off the box, on any focus.

As of 267236c, TopBar draws the bar, a trail of plain words (the last in the action weight), the palette's button with its word and a key cap, and actions. Not yet: crumbs as links with a hover, code crumbs, trailEnds ancestor and the back chevron, the mark, the search field and /, the button beside a search field, keys shown only when bound, the menu button, the phone layout (last crumb, palette as a finger-square icon), the room for a panel toggle and for the window's buttons.
